description: Exact recurrence-universal kernel, n-only monic no-go, proper-target kernel, fixed-window state, and degree-one lift equivalence
open: an orbit-specific polynomial or rational coefficient congruence for q_0=q_1=1
a factorization-independent O(n)-height lift for a proper de-overlapped Q
a nonzero O(n)-height fixed-degree annihilator resultant for the actual residual
the Item282 common product baseline and weighted-return cover
the uniform beta prime-power-height or little-oh squarefull theorem
Route 1 and every conclusion about e+pi

theorem.capacity: no actual low-height orbit-specific annihilator or resultant bound is proved; the Item282 product baseline stays open
theorem.degree_one: U+a annihilates -Y^2 mod Q iff a=Y^2-kQ; equivalently v=-a is exactly an integer lift of -Y^2 mod Q
theorem.deoverlap: proper Q may be any divisor of q_n/gcd(q_n,D_m)
theorem.fixed_window: every fixed recurrence window is an A-linear form in the two algebraically free state variables X,Y
theorem.full_kernel: for generic state variables X,Y, the kernel of X->0 and U->-Y^2 on A[X,Y,U] is exactly (X,U+Y^2)
theorem.n_only_no_go: no positive-degree monic M in A[U], A=Q(n) or a denominator localization, is a recurrence-universal annihilator
theorem.proper_target_kernel: for every integer Q>=2, the kernel of Z[Y,U]->(Z/QZ)[Y], U->-Y^2, is exactly (Q,U+Y^2)
theorem.scope: the theorem excludes recurrence-universal identities, not an arithmetic congruence special to the beta seed q_0=q_1=1
theorem.state_dependent_classification: every universal annihilator is (U+Y^2)G+XH and therefore retains the boundary state or recurrence modulus
